title: Elite: Absolve the Cherub Threshold Bastion: Lughching Law
description: Elite: Absolve the Cherub Threshold Bastion: Lughching Law is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Choir-Vault Discord Ascent through The Choir-Vault Gate (Wound Gate leaking memory-burning radiance). Your avatar of one selected deity's avatar from Michael, Sophia, Shekinah, Gabriel enters; this beat spotlights Gabriel as the reference silhouette while preserving Avatar choice. The mission is the hazard step at Cherub Threshold Bastion, using vertical cathedral ascent and judgment machinery pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Radiant Hierarchies is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use white-gold radiance, many-eye auras, glass armor, feathered and non-feathered wing geometries, bell-metal joints, choral vibration lines, living scroll seals, stair-ladders of light, cathedral vault anatomy, ophanim wheels, seraph fire, cherub guardian masks.
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Choir-Vault Discord Ascent is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Cherub Threshold Bastion and reveals: How seraph flame burns corruption and memory alike. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: Earth — Hollowed City Ruins. shattered skyscrapers twisted by Gate energy, streets split open with void-mist seeping through, abandoned vehicles fused with stone, broken bridges. Neutral ground — no faction advantage or penalty. The Gate has reshaped this terrain.
